fields.name: header_magic_prefix
fields.evidence: Identical in both valid .sav files; FUN_080172e8 4xu32 compare loop over struct base; checksum covers offset 0 and verifies.

fields.name: header_variable_word
fields.evidence: Only differing payload word between samples (hexdump_and_diffs.txt offsets 0x04-0x07); cannot be fixed magic because both saves were retained/loaded; code role beyond template comparison unknown.

fields.name: header_magic_suffix
fields.evidence: Identical in both valid .sav files and inside the compared 16-byte range; interpreted as constant data/framework identifier, not gameplay state.

fields.name: records_x3
fields.evidence: Record stride/count and sort key from FUN_0801744c/FUN_0801760c bodies (static, different literal base); byte layout and ASCII fragments observed identically in both .sav files; no sample variation to verify semantics.

fields.name: zero_region_a
fields.evidence: All zero in both samples; only static sanitizer overlap (hypothesized base) suggests reserved counters/flags. Distinguished from 0xFF fill: these zeros are inside the checksummed, written payload (EEPROM-written zeros, not erased state).

fields.name: tail_fields_and_settings_hypothesis
fields.evidence: Offsets from FUN_0801744c/FUN_08016dbc bodies (static, unrecovered literal bases); values in both .sav files are in-range zeros except 0x7E/0x7F. No variation between samples.

fields.name: zero_region_b
fields.evidence: Inside checksummed payload and written by FUN_080125b4; all zero in both samples; only static clamp hypothesis touches +0x80.

fields.name: checksum_complement_be
fields.evidence: Python recomputation matches stored BE value on both files; sav[0x88:0x90] == reverse(pack('<I',sum)+pack('<I',~sum)) verified true on both.

fields.name: checksum_sum_be
fields.evidence: Python: computed 0x00000741/0x0000086b equals stored BE on both files; inter-sample delta +298 equals 'PMID' insertion byte sum.

fields.name: unused_eeprom_fill
fields.evidence: Byte scan: zero non-0xFF bytes at >=0x90 in both files; no call site references block indices >=18.
